blurb: Austin Rifle Club is a non-profit, all-volunteer organization dedicated to shooting sports and education in safe gun handling. The club operates a private range near Manor, TX, with multiple shooting bays and disciplines. Membership is required for range access, with guests allowed under supervision and limits.
extraNote: Memberships are annual and prorated for first year based on join month · $200 initiation fee to join · Guests allowed only twice per year and must be supervised by full member · No range reservations except for matches, classes, and events · Range closed during monthly Work Day (2nd Saturday 8am-12pm) · Probationary members have no guest privileges or voting rights · ARC Education Building / Range F /16200 Littig Rd, Manor TX
